title: Choose u and dv
text: Think of the integrand as $$1\ln\left(x\right)$$. Let $$u=ln(x)$$ and $$dv=dx$$, so $$du=\frac{1}{x} dx$$ and $$v=x$$.

title: Apply integration by parts
text: The integral equals $$x \ln\left(x\right)$$ minus the integral of $$x \frac{1}{x}=1$$. The integral of $$1$$ is $$x$$, so the answer is $$x \ln\left(x\right)-x+C$$.
